items.en: UAC delivers second 2026 batch of Su-34 fighter-bombers; number of aircraft not disclosed

items.en: Russia's Dan-T munition blurs line between UAVs, cruise missiles — Rostec claims S-71M, S-71K and Dan-T jet drones form a new drone-missile class

items.sEn: Russian state corporation Rostec, in comments to the Defence Ministry newspaper Krasnaya Zvezda (30 September) and to TASS, claims that three of its newest jet-powered strike drones — the S-71M, S-71K and Dan-T — form a new category between attack drones and cruise missiles. items.en: Ukraine's Defence Intelligence discloses 155 Ruselectronics enterprises supplying components for Russian weapons

items.sEn: Ukraine's Defence Intelligence (HUR) has published data on 155 enterprises that are part of, or managed by, the Ruselectronics (Roselektronika) holding, a subsidiary of Russia's state corporation Rostec.
